panels.title: Ingest: Stream Connected
panels.description: RFC-0001 Phase 3 PR-B (ADR-0002): 1 while the WatchItemEvents stream to the backend is connected, 0 while reconnecting. Feeds the AnalyticsStreamDown alert together with up{job="analytics"}.

panels.title: Ingest: Last Event Staleness
panels.description: time() - analytics_last_event_time_seconds -- the degenerate single-source watermark (ADR-0005 D1). Rises during a disconnect (the same signal the canary's pipeline-lag metric measures from the other end), resets on the next ingested event. Gated on the gauge being > 0 so a fresh process that has never ingested an event (gauge still at its zero-value default) shows no data instead of a spurious multi-decade staleness reading.

panels.title: Ingest: Reconnects (total)
panels.description: analytics_reconnects_total -- cumulative reconnect attempts since process start (ADR-0002 backoff loop). Compare against the Reconnect Rate panel to tell a one-off blip from a sustained outage.

panels.title: Ingest: Deduplicated Events (total)
panels.description: analytics_events_deduplicated_total -- stream events dropped by the item_events ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING guard (idempotent replay after a reconnect). Expected to tick up around every reconnect; a high steady-state rate outside reconnects would be unusual.

panels.title: Ingest: Events Ingested Rate by Type
panels.description: sum(rate(analytics_events_ingested_total[5m])) by (event_type) -- bounded label set (created|updated|deleted). Only counts genuinely new events (dedup-guarded replays are excluded, see Deduplicated Events).

panels.title: Ingest: Reconnect Rate
panels.description: rate(analytics_reconnects_total[5m]) -- a nonzero, climbing rate means the client is actively retrying against a still-unreachable backend, not stuck silently. Zero at steady state is the healthy baseline.

panels.title: Ingest: Events Ingested (last 24h) by Type
panels.description: increase(analytics_events_ingested_total[24h]) by (event_type) -- approximates event_buckets' 24h totals via the whitebox ingest counter. Prometheus is the only datasource wired so far (D5): a Postgres datasource reading event_buckets/current_items directly for true historical dashboards arrives with the RFC-0001 Phase 5 seeder work, not before.
